notes.title: Riptide GP2 Steam - Update 1 (Apr 7, 2014)
notes.content:
This is our first update to the Steam version of Riptide GP2, which includes a handful of asked-for feature enhancements and a few minor fixes. All users are [b]strongly encouraged[/b] to update to this latest version! The largest enhancement is Online Multiplayer QuickMatch Mode:
[list]
[*]Allows you to see who else is in the Lobby with you.
[*]Allows you to join a Match that's in progress at the next Race start.
[*]Shows you the status of each racer while you're waiting.
[*]Allows up to 6 players to race simultaneously!
[/list]
[h1]Highlights - Update 1 (Apr 7, 2014):[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added [b]Multiplayer Waiting Room[/b] for Quick Match
[*]Fixed Cloud Sync issue for save data. You can now sync properly on multiple machines.
[*]Increased MP Stability
[*]Graphical enhancements
[*]Art improvements
[*]Economy tweaks to rider progression
[*]Various other bug fixes
[/list]
[h1]Full Changes - Update 1 (Apr 7, 2014):[/h1]
[list]
[*]Waiting Room Screen for matchmaking
[*]Cloud Sync fix
[*]Added fresnel term compute to jetski paint shader
[*]UI focus state bug fixes
[*]Removal of unnecessary UI text
[*]Helmet tweak
[*]Rider female model tweak for shoulder and groin
[*]Rider Shoulder texture and mesh tweaks
[*]Updated Display Settings
[*]QuickMatch now tries to join you in lobbies with people from your friends list, if found.
[*]Render state cache bug fix and performance improvement
[*]Attract mode camera target bug fixed
[*]Adjustments to the starting grid
[*]Cross-version incompability enforcement added
[/list]
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thank you for all the great feedback! We maintain a prioritized list of issues that are reported by our players so don't hesitate to hit is up for fixes, changes, etc. in the Steam Riptide GP2 Official Game Group Discussion Forums!

notes.title: Join us for Multiplayer Beta Testing on Tuesday 4/1
notes.content:
We're just about done with our update, which improves multiplayer connectivity primarily by allowing players to join games in progress.  We've been testing it in-house for the last week, but as you can imagine with only 4 developers it gets a little hard to conduct a proper multiplayer test.

We're looking for volunteers to participate in a wider multiplayer beta test on [b]Tuesday, April 1, from 4-6pm Pacific Time[/b] (and no, it's not an April Fools gag :-) ).  Of course you'd be welcome to play the beta before and after that but that's when we're trying to get as many people playing as possible.

We are looking for volunteers who:
[list]
[*] Already own the game
[*] Can be available to play online for an hour on Tuesday April 1 between 4-6 Pacific Time
[*] Are willing to actively participate in the Vector Unit Beta discussion group to report any errors or issues you encounter.
[*] Understand that while you have the beta installed you won't be able to play online with other players who [b]don't[/b] have the beta installed.
[/list]
If you'd like to participate, please send an email titled "Riptide GP2 Steam Beta" to info@vectorunit.com.  Be sure to include your Steam Name in the email.  

- Matt

PS. Assuming the test goes well, we will have the update ready to push before the end of the week.
